jobs.description:
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Employment Type: Full Time
Department: Global Operations
About Commure
At Commure, we’re building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation, intelligent Agents, and autonomous RCM processing, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.
Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden, and Commure is focused on transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions.
About the Role
We are looking for a Data Operations Analyst to join our RCM Global Operations team. This individual will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of key processes and data, supporting the mission to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of healthcare providers. This is a high-impact role requiring extreme attention to detail, a focus on quality, and the ability to work across different functions to maintain the highest standards. The role requires a commitment to excellence, the ability to handle ambiguity, and a passion for continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Quality Assurance & Documentation
Conduct quality assurance checks on operational processes, ensuring that all details are correct and there are zero errors.
Process Adherence
Follow detailed processes meticulously and ensure documentation is comprehensive and up-to-date.
Data Analysis
Analyze large datasets and perform quality checks using SQL and other tools to identify discrepancies, optimize processes, and support business decisions.
Instruction Creation
Write detailed instructions and process documents, ranging from simple to complex, to guide internal teams effectively.
Communication
Communicate clearly and effectively in both written and verbal formats, ensuring that complex topics are explained in an easily understandable manner.
Cross-Team Collaboration
Work closely with different teams, such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Account Management, to uphold quality standards and solve emerging issues.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Ability to spot discrepancies and ensure accuracy in all aspects of the role.
Experience with SQL for data querying and analysis, including working with large datasets to maintain data integrity.
Strong documentation skills with the ability to create, maintain, and follow detailed process documentation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly.
A mindset of taking full ownership of responsibilities and a commitment to high-quality output.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage ambiguity effectively.
Work Details
Shift: Night Shift, 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM BST
Workdays: Monday to Friday
Information Security Requirement
Employees will act in accordance with Commure’s information security policies, including protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction, or interference. Employees will report confirmed or potential security events or other risks to the information security office and will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and annually.
Official Communication
All official communication from Commure will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com . Emails from other domains are not affiliated with the organization.

jobs.description:
Position: Business Performance Analyst (Shops) – Quick Commerce
Job Ref ID: JR0085714
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Job Type: On-site

About the Role
We are looking for a data-driven operations professional with a strong background in Business Performance or Business Analytics. This role owns the operational performance of foodpanda’s Quick Commerce Shops portfolio by analysing KPIs, identifying root causes, building dashboards, and leading cross-functional improvement initiatives to deliver measurable business impact. The role is expected to independently own operational outcomes across the Shops portfolio, lead cross-functional initiatives, manage complex operational projects with minimal supervision, and proactively identify opportunities to improve operational performance at scale.
Key Responsibilities
Shops Performance Management
Own the operational performance of the QC Shops portfolio across Bangladesh.
Monitor, analyze, and improve operational performance across key business and fulfillment metrics, including:
Item Not Found (InF)
Vendor Offline Rate
Vendor Fail Rate
Perfect Fulfillment Rate (PFR)
Order Acceptance Rate
Cancellation Rate
Replacement Offered %
Picker Utilisation
Orchestration SKU Coverage & Stock
Assortment availability
Identify operational risks and recurring performance issues through data analysis.
Perform root cause analyses and develop structured action plans to improve vendor performance.
Partner closely with Account Managers to implement operational improvement initiatives for underperforming vendors.
Conduct joint vendor visits where required to validate operational issues and ensure agreed actions are implemented.
Measure, monitor, and report the business impact of operational improvement initiatives.
Strategic Retail Partner Expansion
Lead the operational execution of strategic retail partner launches from planning through post-launch stabilization.
Coordinate operational readiness across Operations, Commercial, Account Management, and partner teams.
Manage launch timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate picker onboarding, training, deployment, and operational readiness for new strategic partner launches.
Ensure operational processes and SOPs are successfully implemented before and after launch.
Monitor launch performance and drive corrective actions where required.
Continuously improve the operating model for strategic retail partners as the business scales.
Picker Operations & Inventory Coordination
Coordinate operational readiness of foodpanda picker teams supporting Shops operations.
Monitor picker training-to-deployment readiness.
Identify stores, categories, and SKUs requiring inventory verification based on operational data.
Define inventory count priorities and provide clear guidance to picker teams on execution.
Monitor inventory check completion, quality, and follow-up actions.
Partner with Account Managers and picker teams to improve stock accuracy, assortment availability, and InF performance.
Field Operations & Store Excellence
Conduct regular field visits to partner stores to validate operational performance, identify root causes, and ensure sustainable improvements are embedded across the vendor network.
Observe fulfillment processes, including picking, packing, and order handover.
Validate compliance with operational SOPs and foodpanda standards.
Deliver operational coaching and guidance to vendor teams and picker teams.
Document findings, assign corrective actions, and ensure timely follow-up.
Support live operational escalations where required while maintaining focus on long-term operational improvement.
Data Analytics & Business Performance
Analyze operational datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Build and maintain operational dashboards and recurring reports using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets to support faster decision-making and proactive performance management.
Support analysis using SQL, Looker, or other business intelligence tools where applicable.
Prepare weekly and monthly business reviews for leadership.
Translate data into actionable recommendations and measurable improvement plans.
Track the effectiveness of operational initiatives and continuously optimize performance.
Operational Excellence & Regional Collaboration
Partner with Regional Operations teams to identify best practices, operating models, and successful initiatives across Delivery Hero markets.
Evaluate, localize, and implement regional initiatives within Bangladesh.
Measure adoption and business impact of implemented initiatives, sharing learnings and recommendations where appropriate.
Support the rollout of new operational tools, product features, and process improvements.
Coordinate cross-functionally with Commercial, Account Management, Product, Logistics, and Data teams.
Develop and continuously improve operational SOPs, playbooks, trackers, and training materials.
Independently lead operational improvement projects from problem identification and solution design through implementation, stakeholder alignment, and impact measurement.
Act as the operational subject matter expert supporting the Account Management team in driving vendor performance improvements.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
4-5 years of experience in Business Performance, Business Analytics, Performance Management, Operations Analytics, Marketplace Analytics, E-commerce Operations, or Quick Commerce.
Experience owning KPIs and performance reporting is strongly preferred.
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills, including Pivot, XLOOKUP, and INDEX-MATCH.
Experience building dashboards and performance reports.
Strong data analysis and KPI management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bangla.
Demonstrated experience managing operational performance and delivering measurable business improvements.
Experience with SQL, Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools is preferred.
Experience working with supermarkets, grocery retailers, marketplaces, or FMCG partners is preferred.
Strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and rapidly changing operational environment.
What We’re Looking For
Strong ownership and accountability.
Highly analytical with excellent problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple operational priorities.
Strong project management and execution capability.
Comfortable working with both operational data and field execution.
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
High attention to detail and operational discipline.

Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Willingness to spend time in the field to understand operational challenges firsthand.
A collaborative mindset with a bias for action and delivering measurable results.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://www.samsara.com/
About the role:
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.
We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.
We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.
This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.
In this role, you will:
Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.
Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.
Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.
Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Minimum requirements for the role:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.
Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.
An ideal candidate also has:
Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.
Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary
$162,400 — $290,000 USD
Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.
We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.
This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.
There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.
What You’ll Help Us Build
The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.
Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:
Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles
Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering
Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management
Job and project tracking
Client and vendor dashboards
Online payments and transaction tracking
Reviews and ratings
Notifications and communications
Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities
Admin tools for managing the platform
Reporting and analytics
Secure management of user, job, and transaction data
And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.
This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.
Who We’re Looking For
We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.
You should be comfortable with:
Full-stack web development
Mobile or cross-platform app development
Strong front-end and back-end development
Multi-user marketplace platforms
User authentication and account management
Payment gateway integrations
Databases and APIs
Third-party integrations
Dashboards and reporting
Secure, scalable application architecture
Cloud hosting and deployment
Testing, maintenance, and optimization
Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications
If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it.
More Than Just Coding
We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.
We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.
You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.
You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.
Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.
This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.
Interested? Tell Us About Yourself
Please send us:
A quick introduction
Your resume or LinkedIn profile
Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built
Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on
What you personally worked on for those projects
Your experience using AI in development
What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why
Your availability
A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.
Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Ontario, Canada
About CircleCI Engineering
CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.
At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.
Team-Agnostic Placement
We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.
What You'll Do
Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.
Set technical direction. You define the approach others build from. When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you're the person who leads the design discussion, writes the ADR, and makes the call.
Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on.
Own the full stack. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. You don't hand off at a layer boundary. You own the outcome.
Obsess over craft. Reliability and responsiveness are design concerns, not afterthoughts. Care about how the interface holds up when stakes are high and hold your team to that same standard.
Champion observability. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand and improve your systems. Operational data drives stability, not just incident response.
Close gaps and fix the conditions that created them. You'll notice gaps and close them. When a gap reflects something broken in how the team works, you fix that too.
What You'll Bring
AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.
A track record of shipping. You've built something real and put it in front of users. 5+ years of production full-stack experience, with latency, responsiveness, and reliability treated as design concerns, not afterthoughts.
Full-stack depth. Strong React and TypeScript. Comfortable owning backend services in Go: API design, data modeling, service integration.
System design. You lead architectural decisions on complex systems. You make conscious tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and create the foundation others build on.
Adaptability. You don't just thrive in ambiguity, you reduce it for others. You turn unclear requirements into a direction the team can execute on.
Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship.
Sound like you?
You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.
Canada Base Pay Range
$156,000 — $196,000 CAD

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.
